title: India imports 88% of its oil. Tomorrow 1 meeting decides what you pay at the pump in 2027. #Shorts
description:
India imports 88% of its oil. Tomorrow (Nov 29), OPEC+ meets to set 2027 output quotas.

What 88.7% crude dependency means for India:
- $74.8B import bill in just 5 months of FY27 (+48% YoY)
- Every $1 rise in Brent = ₹850 Cr extra monthly outflow
- HPCL, BPCL, IOC margins directly at risk

Watch 3 signals tomorrow:
1. OPEC+ quota: rollover vs. ease
2. Brent crude price post-announcement
3. HPCL, BPCL, IOC + current account deficit
